title: seams detect --json
description: The seams detection proposes for a repo, for a person to confirm: each with its provider, consumers, evidence by file and line, and confidence. Candidates the registry has rejected are left out.

component.description: A part of the repo that can take part in a seam: a directory with a manifest, named by it, or a top-level directory with none, named by the directory.

dir.description: Its directory, from the repo's root; . for the root.

manifest.description: The manifest that names it: go.mod, package.json, pyproject.toml or serverless.yml.

id.description: Derived as the registry's ids are, so it matches a registered seam, or a rejection, by id. Its name is api for a provider's one API of a kind, when the evidence doesn't name it.

provider.description: Who the evidence says provides it, or null when it doesn't say, or when several parties do.

consumers.description: The parties the evidence shows using it; empty when none is seen, such as for a public API.

contract.description: A contract file that describes it, from the repo's root.

confidence.description: The strongest evidence's, one higher when two or more signals agree, and at most medium with no known provider.

notes.description: What the person confirming it should know.

signal.description: The kind of evidence; docs/DETECTION.md describes each.

role.description: The party's part: provides; consumes; owns, which provides unless other evidence names a provider; or supports, which makes the seam likelier without naming it.

text.description: The line, trimmed, and cut at 120 characters.
